# gitmoap_group_member (Data Source)

Get a specific group member. Returns one person's direct role on the group. A group's roster is not public, even when the group is: the caller must be signed in and able to see who has access here (Reporters and above with the built-in roles).

The token needs `group_member:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_user_by_username" "ada" {
  username = "ada"
}

data "gitmoap_group_member" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
  user_id  = data.gitmoap_user_by_username.ada.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID
- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `access_level` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `parent_group_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
